The deep entry filled when the zone sat under a sell-side pool (Asia low + EQL) that London had to sweep - the inverse of the NO_PULLBACK cases, where the entry sat beyond an already swept pool. 09.11 am: TP - BUY 1.40880 in the H4 bull FVG (under the Asia low + EQL pool London had to sweep) reached TP1 1.41240 at 16:05, +1.07R / +36.0 pips; first long TP in the journal, run capped at the PWH/EQH 1.41374-1.41391. Deep entry under an unswept sell-side pool: 1 of 1 filled and paid. 10.11 am: EXPIRED (DEEP_ENTRY #4) - BUY 1.40999 at OTE 62% under the H1 low 1.41096; London swept that pool by 3.6 pips (low 1.41060, 6.1 pips short, 65% of path) and ran: TP1 10:45, TP3 14:50 on CPI. review.proposal: Longs: entry 1-2 pips beyond the sell-side pool London has to sweep (not at OTE 62% below it); shorts mirrored under the nearest unswept EQH. Skip the order when the entry sits in the wrong D1 half (long above 70% / short below 30%) right after a sweep of the opposite pool.
